# Ricardo Andrés Calvo Méndez

> Academic website of Ricardo Andrés Calvo Méndez (publishes as R. Calvo), a PhD student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at Purdue University, working on formal verification, memory-safety verification, program analysis, and automated software testing in the Duality Lab under James C. Davis.

## Main pages

- [Profile](https://rcalvom.github.io/): research interests, selected work, technical skills, education, experience, teaching, academic service, and grants.
- [Publications](https://rcalvom.github.io/publications/): publication records and links to papers, slides, and BibTeX.
- [Talks and presentations](https://rcalvom.github.io/talks/): conference talks and poster presentations.
- [CV](https://rcalvom.github.io/cv/): web CV, the official academic CV PDF, and the professional résumé PDF.
- [About me](https://rcalvom.github.io/about-me/): personal background and photography.
